headlines.title: Southern Company to Report Q3 Earnings: Here's How It Will Fare
headlines.summary: SO's Q3 earnings are expected to benefit from rising data center demand, higher electricity sales and customer growth, although elevated expenses may weigh on profitability.

headlines.title: Did Bylaw Changes Just Shift Southern's (SO) Investment Narrative?
headlines.summary: Southern Company has amended and restated its bylaws, adjusted shareholder meeting and voting rules, and confirmed a regular quarterly dividend of US$0.76 per share payable in December 2026. New forum selection rules and refreshed procedures for shareholder proposals and director nominations could change how investors influence Southern Company’s long term capital and governance decisions.

headlines.title: Southern (SO) Names New Leaders Across Its Utility Operations
headlines.summary: Southern (NYSE:SO) announced a series of executive leadership changes aimed at supporting its growth and infrastructure investment plans. The firm named a new president of Southern Company Operations to oversee systemwide generation and transmission functions. Georgia Power will have a new chair, president, and CEO, shifting leadership at one of Southern's key operating utilities.

headlines.title: 2026 Fortnightly Top Innovators Awards Recognize Breakthroughs in Grid Modernization, Resilience, and Load Growth Solutions
headlines.summary: Top Honors Awarded to ComEd, National Grid, Southern Company, TS Conductor, and VeoliaWASHINGTON, D.C., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Five organizations — ComEd, National Grid, Southern Company, TS Conductor, and Veolia — have been named winners of the 2026 Fortnightly Top Innovators Awards.

description: The Southern Company, through its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of electricity. The company offers electric service to retail customers and wholesale customers; and energy-related products and services to natural gas choice markets. It also develops, constructs, acquires, owns, operates, and manages power generation assets, as well as battery energy storage projects; sells electricity at market-based rates in the wholesale market; and deploys microgrids for commercial, industrial, governmental, and utility customers. In addition, the company is involved in the distribution of natural gas in Illinois, Georgia, Virginia, and Tennessee; distributes energy and resilience solutions; and invests in telecommunications. The Southern Company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
